t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. E meinga ana e au, E toku Atua, Nâu au i hanga ki a mõhio ki a Koe a ki a koropiko ki a Koe. E whaka puaki ana au, i tenei wa, ki toku ngoikore a ki Tôu kaha, ki toku pohara a ki Tou oranga. Kahore he Atua i tua atu ko Koe anake, te Awhina i roto i te Mate, te Mana noho Motuhake.
